title: Ossan Sour
notes: It's mostly sweet and sour, you can taste the whiskey, it's a bit like a whiskey sour but it has a bit more depth I think because of the apricot.
ingredients:
• Nikka from the barrel
  • Lillet (blanc?)

  • "A smokey spritz"?
method: Shake ingredients over ice, serve up or over ice, spritz with liquid smoke I guess?
